description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for a stem graphics object.

tr.td: updates the annotation metadata used by object inspection.
Type: graphics annotation object or empty handle value. Supported values: an annotation object associated with the graphics item, or an empty graphics handle.
stores the baseline graphics object when one is associated with the stem chart.
Type: graphics object handle. Supported values: empty vector or a baseline handle.
sets the z value where stems start.
Type: numeric scalar. Supported values: finite scalar.
Nelson computes this value; graphics operations update it.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off' or 'on'.
controls whether an interrupting callback is queued or canceled.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'queue' or 'cancel'.
runs when the object receives a mouse-button event.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
parenting operations update the vector.
Type: graphics object handle vector. Supported values: empty vector or child handles.
controls clipping at the axes limits.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
sets the stem line and default marker color.
Type: color value. Supported values: color short name, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], or hexadecimal color.
'auto' lets Nelson choose the color from the axes color order; 'manual' preserves the assigned value.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
attaches the menu used for context-click actions.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a uicontextmenu handle.
runs when the object is created.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
updates the content used for interactive data tips.
Type: data tip template object or empty handle value. Supported values: a data tip template object owned by the graphics item, or an empty graphics handle.
runs when the object is deleted.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
sets the label used by legends and object inspectors.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: any text value.
controls whether the handle is returned by handle-finding functions.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
controls whether the object can receive mouse events.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
controls whether callbacks can be interrupted.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
sets the style of stem lines.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: '-', '--', ':', '-.', or 'none'.
'auto' lets Nelson choose the line style; 'manual' preserves the assigned value.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
sets the stem line width.
Type: numeric scalar. Supported values: nonnegative finite scalar in points.
sets the marker drawn at each data point.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: line marker symbols such as 'o', '+', '*', '.', 'x', 's', 'd', '^', 'v', '>', '<', 'p', 'h', or 'none'.
sets the marker edge color.
Type: color value or mode text. Supported values: 'auto', 'none', color short name, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], or hexadecimal color.
sets the marker fill color.
Type: color value or mode text. Supported values: 'auto', 'none', color short name, RGB triplet with values in [0,1], or hexadecimal color.
'auto' lets Nelson choose the marker; 'manual' preserves the assigned value.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
sets marker size.
Type: numeric scalar. Supported values: nonnegative finite scalar in points.
sets the graphics parent.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: axes or hggroup handle.
controls which visible parts can receive mouse events.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'visible', 'all', or 'none'.
marks the object as selected.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
controls selection highlighting.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
stores the series index used with axes style order.
Type: numeric scalar. Supported values: positive finite scalar.
controls whether a baseline is shown for the stem chart.
Type: on/off value. Supported values: 'on', 'off', true, or false.
stores the source table for table-based inputs.
Type: table-like data value or empty value. Supported values: [] or source data container.
stores user-defined object identifier text.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: any text value.
identifies the graphics object type.
Type: read-only text scalar. Supported values: 'stem'.
stores user-defined data associated with the object.
Type: any Nelson value. Supported values: any value.
controls object visibility.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on' or 'off'.
sets x coordinates for the stem points.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: finite or nonfinite numeric values.
'auto' lets Nelson generate x data; 'manual' preserves assigned data.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
stores the workspace expression used as x data source.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: any text value or ''.
stores the source variable used for x data.
Type: text, numeric, or empty value. Supported values: variable name, index, or empty value.
sets y coordinates for the stem points.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: finite or nonfinite numeric values.
'auto' lets Nelson generate y data; 'manual' preserves assigned data.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
stores the workspace expression used as y data source.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: any text value or ''.
stores the source variable used for y data.
Type: text, numeric, or empty value. Supported values: variable name, index, or empty value.
sets z coordinates for the stem points.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: finite or nonfinite numeric values.
'auto' lets Nelson generate z data; 'manual' preserves assigned data.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto' or 'manual'.
stores the workspace expression used as z data source.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: any text value or ''.
stores the source variable used for z data.
Type: text, numeric, or empty value. Supported values: variable name, index, or empty value.
